company.description: Junction Bioscience is a pharmaceutical firm that is developing an autonomous AI scientist to guide the discovery of breakthrough drugs. It provides products and services in the field of biotechnology. The company develops solutions for research and laboratory applications. It offers tools and reagents for biological experiments. The platform supports data collection and analysis for scientific studies. Junction Bioscience provides technical support and guidance for laboratory use. The company works with research institutions and organizations to deliver biological products.
